name: the history page count is 1 again
why: Before 2026-10-29 _dgHistPageCount() read a pager no history page has, so only page 1 (the OLDEST changes) was read, for releases too.
grep: a master's history page has the button

name: an artist's diff is read with release markup only
why: An artist's or label's diff holds bare div.head + div.content pairs; without the :scope > .head arm it has no block at all, in the pageType and in the window.
grep: a artist's history page has the button

name: the history path pattern is release-only again
why: A master's, artist's or label's history page would get no dg-history button (and fail the #app gate).

name: dg-master takes its own history page
why: _dgPage()'s path pattern is not anchored at the end, so the master pageType (earlier in pageDefinitions) would claim /master/<id>/history first.
